text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You lookin' down on us?!
You think eating just tofu for lunch is gonna beat us?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
My weight has increased recently.
I must make sure it doesn't affect my racing.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Veggies are great for cutting weight! Eat up!
Conditioning our bodies is the basics for us, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So meals are also a part of training.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I make my meals with nutritional balance in mind.
Focusing on protein while keeping the calories low.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, as a result of keeping it up every day,
I managed to successfully lose weight.”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I don't need your thanks.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat you down in a race when you're at your best!
Otherwise... it just wouldn't be any fun!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
In that case... I'll pay you back on the track, then.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Still—I'm surprised.
You're so caring, and a great cook too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh!? Who're you callin' your mom?!
You lookin' for a fight, punk?!
